name: The Mirror Doesn't Lie
source:
The death of your father brings you back to the place you swore you’d never see again. The house stands quiet, its silence too deep to trust. But memory seeps through every crack, calling your name in echoes and fragments. 

You must decide what to face – and what to leave buried.

[From [url=https://laneyscastle.itch.io/the-mirror-doesnt-lie]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你父亲的去世让你回到了你发誓再也见不到的地方。房子里很安静，安静得令人难以置信。但记忆渗透进每一个裂缝，在回声和碎片中呼唤着你的名字。

你必须决定要面对什么——以及要埋葬什么。

[来自[url=https://laneyscastle.itch.io/the-mirror-doesnt-lie]Itch.io[/url]]
